title: Returned-Payment Fees and FlexLine Limit Increases
content:
| Returned-payment fee entries on the FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit line in the last 12 months | Share of the increase |
|---|---|
| exactly one | 0.75 |
| two or more | 0.50 |
| none | 1.00 |

The returned-fee share scales a limit increase by the returned-payment fee entries on the line in the last 12 months: exactly one gives 0.75; two or more give 0.50; none gives 1.00. The share multiplies the increase before it is added to the current credit limit and the sum rounded down.

The last 12 months take the entries dated after the same day of the month 12 months before the decision date. Every returned-payment fee entry dated in that window counts, whatever its amount.

*Hypothetical figure:* an increase of 2000.00 USD with one returned-payment fee entry in the window becomes 1500.00 USD.
